title: Meal planner
demo: Meal plans need an account. Log in to plan your meals.
demoOnly: This doesn't work with sample data. Log in to plan your meals.
checkConnection: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No meal plan yet
empty.message: Plan your meals by hand, or let the app fill a week from your saved recipes. Then add the ingredients to a shopping list.

weekEmpty: Nothing is planned in this week. Tap a slot to pick a recipe, or use Auto-plan.
caloriesNote: Calories are estimates from the recipes, for one person.

new.title: New meal plan
new.name: Name
new.shared: Everyone in {{name}} can see and change this plan. It uses the household's recipes.
new.personal: Only you can see this plan.

delete.title: Delete this plan?
delete.message: {{name}} and all its meals are deleted for everyone who can see it. Your recipes and shopping lists stay.

wizard.noPlan: Open the planner and choose a plan first.
wizard.fillError: Could not fill the plan. Try again.

problem.calories: Calories per day must be a number between 500 and 10,000.
problem.minutes: Time per meal must be a number of minutes, like 30.

wizard.intro: Tell the planner what you want. It picks from your saved recipes, and never invents a meal. Leave a goal empty to ignore it.
wizard.caloriesHelp: Uses the nutrition estimates of your recipes. Recipes without an estimate are left out when you set this.
wizard.daysIntro: Skip days or single meals, and change the servings for a day. Skipped meals stay empty.

result.filledMessage: Every meal you asked for has a recipe. You can change any of them by hand in the plan.
result.partlyMessage_one: {{count}} meal stayed empty because no saved recipe matches. Save more recipes, or loosen your goals and try again.
result.partlyMessage_other: {{count}} meals stayed empty because no saved recipe matches. Save more recipes, or loosen your goals and try again.

slot.noRecipes: You have no saved recipes yet.
slot.noHouseholdRecipes: A household plan uses the household's recipes. None are shared yet.

list.title: Add ingredients to a shopping list
list.intro: Amounts are scaled to the servings of each meal, and the same ingredients are merged. Nothing is added until you tap the button.
list.weekEmpty: Nothing is planned in this week.
list.none: You have no shopping lists yet. Make one in the Shopping tab.
list.nothing: There are no meals to add.
list.added_one: Added the ingredients of {{count}} meal to {{name}}.
list.added_other: Added the ingredients of {{count}} meals to {{name}}.
